row: The Faculty of Science is a thriving, passionate and internationally networked community with a history of leadership in research, innovation, teaching and learning. Comprising seven schools, the Faculty offers a range of undergraduate, honours, graduate and research degrees; enrolling over 6,500 undergraduate and graduate students. We also provide community services and industry partnerships based on a solid foundation of research in the pure, and applied sciences.
